_about: Military Warehouses (maps_dict 43) in Free for All with a twist only (the owner, 2026-11-22: "military warehouses should not be playable on general ffa, only ffa: racket and other variants"): srp's key mode.srp_twists_only = true in its config, which the server reads (survarium maps::MapMode::twists_only): a room's card on it draws a twist and never plain Free for All, a private room's pool leaves it out (docs/notes/ffa.md, "Twists").
